jobs.text:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

jobs.text: About the Role As Director Business Development at SkyNRG, you will lead the team responsible for growing our SAFc business with large corporate customers. You will set the sales strategy, develop key customer relationships, and build the commercial capabilities needed to support the next stage of growth. A key part of your role will be taking our sales approach to the next level. You will bring greater structure and consistency to how we manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation and qualification through to proposals, negotiation and contracting. You will lead and develop the Business Development team while remaining closely involved in strategic accounts and complex commercial negotiations.
